surface_follow.label: Follow surfaces
surface_follow.description: Dragging moves the view center along terrain and object surfaces. Turn it off to keep the current height and pass through obstacles.

camera_gizmo.label: Camera Gizmo
camera_gizmo.description: Overlays the camera grid the rays are cast through, one ray a cell, and colors the world by its drawn cells against the zoom the grid asks there: green at it, blue finer, red coarser.

rays.label: Rays
rays.description: Who casts the rays the screen draws, and how many.

cpu.label: CPU
cpu.description: The CPU's cast, one ray a cell of the camera grid.

cells.label: GPU, grid cells
cells.description: The GPU, one ray a cell of the camera grid.

half.label: GPU, half resolution
half.description: One ray every second CSS pixel each way.

ray_steps.label: Ray steps
ray_steps.description: Colors each ray by the nodes its descent asked the world: blue few, red many, the same ramp on every screen.
